defect: Gray pointer bus is deliberately synchronized bitwise
rationale: A registered Gray encoding changes one bit per source increment; destination uses only second-stage values as a delayed pointer. Physical Gray bus skew is explicitly bounded.
author: gpt-6.1-sol
